name: Free Online Screen Ruler - ATools
description: Free online Screen Ruler. Runs locally in your browser with zero uploads for privacy and speed.
seoDescription: The ultimate free online Screen Ruler — ATools (Pure Tools). 100% free, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking: everything runs locally in your browser for maximum privacy. Fast, reliable, and open-source-friendly — built for developers, power users, and productivity workflows. Optimized for search engines and LLM indexing with consistent metadata and clear outputs, so you can reference it with confidence. If you want a "just works" Screen Ruler on any device, this is the one you bookmark and share.

ui.uncalibratedTip: Uncalibrated: Showing pixel values only. Switch to "Calibrate" to convert to cm/in.
ui.measureTip: Tip: Drag points A and B to measure. Drag together when overlapping to move both.
ui.calibrateGuide: Align points A and B with a known physical object, enter its length in mm, and save.
ui.calibrateTip: Tip: Use a standard credit card (85.6 mm) or a physical ruler to calibrate. Fullscreen mode is recommended.
